project_name: BintangKelas - Flipped Classroom IPAS Kelas 6 SD
theme: Cheerful Blue & Teal (Biru Ceria & Toska) Educational Dual-Mode App
target_audience: Siswa Kelas 6 SD (11-12 Tahun) & Guru IPAS Sekolah Dasar
design_archetype: Pastel & Soft Friendly Education + Clean Modern Dashboard

feature_1_mode_siswa_chat.description: WhatsApp-style vertical chat interface tailored for 6th grade elementary students.
components: Greeting message from Kak Bintang with voice note audio toggle simulation
Quick Reply Buttons (e.g. 'Mulai Belajar 🚀', 'Lihat Organ 🍎', 'Coba Kuis 📝')
3 Sequential Learning Cards (Materi 1: Mulut & Kerongkongan, Materi 2: Lambung & Usus Halus, Materi 3: Usus Besar & Anus) with diagrams and interactive popup info
Diagnostic Quiz Module: 3 Interactive Multiple Choice Questions with immediate feedback explanations and score tally
Student Attendance Form: Form input for Nama Lengkap and Nomor Absen, with Kirim Kehadiran button
Completion Banner & Confetti effect on submit

feature_2_mode_guru_dashboard.description: KBM Dashboard for Teacher with data analytics, presentation slides, and Kurikulum Merdeka daily journal.
components: Header Stats: Total Siswa Akses (e.g. 28/30), Rata-rata Skor (84.5), Miskonsepsi Terdeteksi (2 Topik), Siap KBM (93%)
Student Recap Table: Name, Absen No, Access Time, Quiz Score, Status Badge (Paham Utuh / Miskonsepsi / Belum Akses), Action Detail
Kartu Analisis Miskonsepsi: Visual insights highlighting misconceptions (e.g., 'Siswa menganggap pencernaan makanan hanya terjadi di lambung') with suggested teacher action points
Adaptive Slide Presenter Viewer: 5-Slide interactive deck viewer with Fullscreen mode, Next/Prev controls, Slide jump menu, and Presenter Notes drawer
Jurnal Harian Guru Table (Kurikulum Merdeka): Official table format ready to copy/print containing TP, Alur Flipped Classroom, Diagnostic Result Summary, and Reflection notes

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the dual mode toggle at top-right switches smoothly between Mode Siswa (WhatsApp-style Android Chat UI) and Mode Guru (KBM Dashboard).

In Mode Siswa, mimic Android WhatsApp UI with Kak Bintang profile, Online status indicator, green header, timestamped chat bubbles, diagnostic quiz cards with instant feedback explanations, and student attendance form.
Include realistic dummy data in Indonesian tailored for Grade 6 SD IPAS (Sistem Pencernaan Manusia: Mulut, Kerongkongan, Lambung, Usus Halus, Usus Besar, Anus).
In Mode Guru, render teacher analytics, misconception cards, 5-slide presentation viewer with fullscreen toggle, and Kurikulum Merdeka Daily Journal table with Print & Copy buttons.
All interactive elements MUST include explicit data-testid attributes for automated testing.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_id_requirement: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, and quiz options MUST include data-testid (e.g. data-testid='mode-toggle-siswa', data-testid='quiz-option-a', data-testid='submit-attendance-btn').
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_headers: Header and overlay backgrounds must use solid or semi-opaque background with blur (e.g. bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) so text remains readable.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply transition: all globally. Apply targeted transitions on hover/focus states.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.file_extension_rule: Use React JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files for components as specified in the frontend repository structure.
